issues.explanation: The analysis (S1/I1/I2) records only that the domain was not connecting; the specific "site can't be reached" error message has no supporting item or evidence (it appears only in the summary).

statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted your custom domain to load your funnel instead of showing a "site can't be reached" error.
Following our guidance, you replaced the old records with CNAME records for your domain and its www version, and you confirmed that both now load your funnel.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
We will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and message you if it has not. We will do this tomorrow morning.
